svg.text: pp1, pp2 = pointers into the POSITION lists (p1, p2 point to docs)

g.text: Step 1/11 Start: positions of term 1 and term 2 in the same doc, k = 3
→ pp1 -> first position of term 1, pp2 -> first position of term 2
→ inside the band -> add 1 to l, move pp2
→ inside the band -> add 4 to l, move pp2
→ pp2 is past the band -> break (pp2 stays at 7)
Step 5/11 clean l: drop values farther than 3 from 2 (none)
Step 8/11 clean l: 1 is 4 away from 5 -> delete 1
Step 11/11 clean l: 4 and 7 are too far from 15 -> delete
→ output (15,12), pp1 ends -> done with this doc
Done: every (term 1 position, term 2 position) pair within 3 words
pp2 never goes back: l keeps the term 2 positions that may still fit the next pp1
